description: This file defines the PackageValidator class responsible for validating if calling packages are authorized to access a media browsing service. It reads allowed caller signatures from an XML resource, stores them, and verifies callers based on their signatures and package names.

classes.name: PackageValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating whether calling packages are authorized based on their signatures and package info.

methods.name: PackageValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator by reading allowed certificates from XML.

methods.name: readValidCertificates
methods.description: Parses an XML resource to populate the map of valid signing certificates associated with caller info.

methods.name: isCallerAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a caller, identified by package name and UID, is authorized to access the media service.
